trigger: run1 G2_base_release21_nomodule FAIL and G2_cand_release21_nomodule FAIL
observed: Throwable.java:258: warning: [this-escape] possible 'this' escape before subclass is fully initialized (5 warnings, pre-existing in the HEAD baseline) + error: warnings found and -Werror specified
correction: java.base gates use make's lint set -Xlint:all,-this-escape (make/modules/java.base/Java.gmk DISABLED_WARNINGS_java += this-escape) and every compile gate has a HEAD-baseline twin
lesson: mirror the build's DISABLED_WARNINGS before reading a -Werror failure as a regression, and diff against a baseline twin

trigger: run1 G4_export_absent_module_werror reported PASS with rc=4
observed: package java.util does not exist: module-info.java passed as an explicit source with --patch-module made javac treat java.base as a new module; the expected-failure gate passed for the wrong reason
correction: the probe module-info.java comes from a patch-path overlay (javac reads it implicitly, as G1 shows) and the gate requires the ERE 'module not found: jdk\.m3\.text'
lesson: an expected-failure gate must assert the failure reason, not only a non-zero exit

trigger: run1 O1_component_javac FAIL followed by O1_component_run executing; M1-M3 runs reported PASS
observed: javac -Werror left partial class output; java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: java/lang/M3StringLeafRanges was counted as a mutant kill
correction: fail closed: a run is NOT_RUN when its javac gate fails; mutant runs require 'java\.lang\.AssertionError' and O1 requires 'M3_LEAF_RANGES_PASS mode=component stringLayout=stock'
guard: oracle() returns before the run; run patterns
lesson: never execute on a failed compile; a mutant kill must be an oracle assertion

observed: module not found: jdk.m3.text reported at module-info.java lines 140, 168, 331, 334, 354: the sed matched every 'jdk.crypto.cryptoki;' clause end, not only jdk.internal.access
correction: sed range-restricted to the 'exports jdk.internal.access to' clause; the edit must apply exactly once
lesson: anchor text edits on the owning clause, then count the hits

observed: patch set held nested classes of stock outer classes (String$M3Construction, SynchronousQueue$TransferStack, MethodHandleNatives$CallSiteContext, JavaLangAccess$M3StringLeafLanes)
correction: patch only new top-level classes and their members; a nested class whose top-level class exists in the stock image is excluded
lesson: a component oracle must not mix M3 members into stock outer classes

observed: module-info.java:1: warning: [module] module name component m3 should avoid terminal digits + -Werror
correction: compile the jdk.m3.text probe with -Xlint:all,-module -Werror (text-tools/build.py precedent); E0 asserts that the full module lint fires
lesson: the jdk.m3.* name itself trips module lint; module-pack compiles keep -module

observed: Error: no value given for --add-options=--add-exports=java.base/jdk.internal.access=jdk.m3.text, then Error: no value given for --add-options
correction: pass the plugin value with a leading space: --add-options ' --add-exports=java.base/jdk.internal.access=jdk.m3.text'
guard: E5 rc=0 and E6 pattern 'PROBE_OK countPositives=2'
lesson: jlink plugin values cannot begin with '--'

trigger: export1 E9_image_unnamed_denied reported PASS with rc=127
observed: the image did not exist (E5 failed); the shell's command-not-found exit satisfied the nonzero expectation
correction: every gate carries an ERE the log must contain (E9: 'does not export jdk\.internal\.access to unnamed module')
lesson: same as G4: assert the failure reason

observed: line 114 held a literal U+00E9: the authoring tool turned the Java escape for U+00E9 into the character; javac read it as UTF-8 so run3 passed
correction: the unit is built as (char) 0xe9; the source is ASCII-only; O1/M1-M3 re-run on the corrected bytes (final run)
lesson: never trust a written Unicode escape; scan staged sources for non-ASCII bytes and re-run the gates bound to the corrected hash
